theory.title: Exercise 2.2.1: The Keywords Section
theory.content:
🔧 Building Your Own Tools

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, you've been using built-in keywords like Log and Should Be Equal. But what if you need a procedure that doesn't exist yet?"

"The *** Keywords *** section lets you build your OWN keywords - custom procedures tailored to your testing needs."

📦 What are Custom Keywords?

Custom Keywords - User-defined procedures that encapsulate test steps

  • ✅ Reusability - Write once, use in multiple tests
  • ✅ Readability - Abstract complex operations with descriptive names
  • ✅ Maintainability - Change implementation in one place
  • ✅ Organization - Group related operations

Why Use Custom Keywords?

  • 🔹 Eliminate duplicate code
  • 🔹 Create domain-specific test language
  • 🔹 Hide implementation details from tests
  • 🔹 Build hierarchical test structure

📝 Keywords Section Structure

*** Settings ***
Documentation    My test suite

*** Test Cases ***
My Test
    My Custom Keyword

*** Keywords ***
My Custom Keyword
    Log    This is my custom keyword
    Log    It can contain multiple steps

Key Rules:

  • ✅ Keywords section comes AFTER Test Cases
  • ✅ Keyword names at left margin (no indentation)
  • ✅ Keyword body indented (2+ spaces, 4 recommended)
  • ✅ Tests call keywords by name

⚙️ Keywords Section Rules

  • 🔹 Header: *** Keywords *** (or singular form)
  • 🔹 Position: After Test Cases, before Variables (if any)
  • 🔹 Naming: Use descriptive, verb-based names
  • 🔹 Indentation: Keyword names flush left, body indented
  • 🔹 Scope: Keywords available to all tests in the file

🎯 Your Task

Create your first custom keyword! Build a test that calls 'Check Power Levels', then define that keyword in the *** Keywords *** section.
